notes.title: February News Update: Articles, Events & Feedback
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580075/613227a4f4bd94137c1fc9f2f778081b88d379c4.png[/img]
Hello Everyone!

Here is the last countdown post we will make before [b]Once A Tale[/b]'s release! Do not worry, we will still keep you updated on the latest news about our game. This only means we are very close to everyone experiencing the full [b]Once A Tale[/b]! 

We wanted to mention how appreciative we are of those who gave us feedback on the game after playing the demo. It has been a big help in fixing things up and setting the game up for success upon release. But first, we have some news related to the events that [b]Once A Tale[/b] was a part of these past weeks, and news about the Devlogs, so lets get right into it!

[h2]Events[/h2]
As you may know, we have been featured in [u]Games from Québec[/u] and in [u]Steam Next Fest[/u] the last couple of weeks. We are excited to say that has helped us tremendously to get closer to our goals before launch!

So welcome to all the new players, [i]thank you[/i] for downloading [b]Once A Tale[/b]'s Demo, and most of all, thank you for adding [b]Once A Tale[/b] to your wishlists!

If you are new and you want to join a growing community, or chat with the devs [url=https://discord.gg/fSchbjr3Nx]here is a link to our discord[/url].

[h3]Article about Once A Tale![/h3]
Thank you to GamesRadar for the kind words in your [url=https://www.gamesradar.com/the-steam-next-fest-demo-for-this-magical-co-op-adventure-game-is-like-a-mix-between-little-nightmares-and-it-takes-two/]recent article about Once A Tale[/url].

"[i]...Once a Tale sees players take control of two children as they explore unfamiliar surroundings, work together to solve puzzles, and uncover the truth of how they got there in the first place. Unlike Little Nightmares, this adventure game is a bit more family-friendly and takes inspiration from the Brothers Grimm story of Hansel and Gretel, as well as other well-known tales. [/i]"

For more, [url=https://www.gamesradar.com/the-steam-next-fest-demo-for-this-magical-co-op-adventure-game-is-like-a-mix-between-little-nightmares-and-it-takes-two/]Click here[/url]

[h2]Devlogs[/h2]
We have been brewing up some more devlogs for you to get an insider look into what it takes to make a stop-motion style game like [b]Once A Tale[/b]. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D6SYGzwxVk0]Click here to watch Devlog #02[/url]!

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
With your feedback, we were able to fix some problems in the full game. After a bit of testing, we should be able to update the demo version as well.
[list]
[*] Mouse and Keyboard controls now work better when the camera changes
[*] You can now turn off Vsync to help performance
[*] ...more!
[/list]


Thank you to everyone for your support, we hope to see you soon with more good news!
The Dev Team

notes.title: January News Update (2 months left!)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580075/00c283d3225d3e20ccba8ef4f9700fcb000a9802.png[/img]

Happy New Year everyone!

There is only a little over 2 months left until [b]Once A Tale[/b] releases and our anticipation builds with every post we make in the countdown.

[h3]Public Demo[/h3]
As you may have heard last week, [b]Once A Tale[/b] has an official [u]demo that is publicly available to play[/u] on Steam! So if you want to get a taste of the enchanting world that we handcrafted, please download the demo and let us know what you think!

[h3]Streams and Giveaways[/h3]
We told you in our last Steam update that we would be announcing a giveaway, so here is the plan:
We are going to host a few streams until the game is released and during those streams, there will be an opportunity to win a copy of [b]Once A Tale[/b]. We can't tell you which one or how many, but there will be at least one!

The next stream will be this Friday, on [u][b]January 19th from 1pm to 3pm EST[/b][/u] time. You can also follow our Twitch Page to be sure not to miss it https://www.twitch.tv/carcajougames !

As always, if you would like to participate in growing the [b]Once A Tale[/b] community, please [url=https://discord.gg/rYr9tEjHqZ]join us on Discord[/url]!

notes.title: December 2023 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580075/18d3fcf5f78108b6b1c96063152f67d3a34232b4.png[/img]

[h1] Three Months Until Release! [/h1]

The holidays are upon us and we hope you are enjoying a warm beverage as you read this update (if not, we understand. You maybe shouldn't bring food near a computer...).

For those of you who have not read the last update, we have a release month and it is [b]March 2024[/b]. In preparation for this big event, we have a few things planned!

[h2]Once A Tale Streams[/h2]

You may have seen that streamers have started playing Once A Tale. Head to Twitch to catch one of them showing some fun gameplay (without big story spoilers). Let us know what you think of the game on our socials or even on [url=https://discord.gg/4DPBQ8h5Fu]Discord[/url]!

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/onceatale/]Reddit[/url] - [url=https://www.facebook.com/carcajougames]Facebook[/url] - [url=https://www.instagram.com/onceatalegame/]Instagram[/url] - [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@carcajougames]TikTok[/url]

[b]Upcoming Once A Tale Streams:[/b]
[list]
[*]3QCrew - Tisir (Fr) : December 17th
[*]Cobmob (De) : December 17th
[*]Guiguicoul (Fr) : December 18th
[*] ... and more!
[/list]

A warm thanks to streamers who have already streamed Once A Tale this month: Hastiles (Fr), Twilitzal (En), UrgentPigeon (Fr).

If you are a streamer yourself, and you would like to be able to stream Once A Tale:  [url=https://discord.gg/4DPBQ8h5Fu]Join our Discord[/url] for more information on how to stream Once A Tale.

[h2]Giveaways[/h2]

The Holidays are the season of giving and we want to give back to our supportive community by hosting a [u][b]giveaway[/b][/u] for a copy of Once A Tale!

Keep an eye on our socials for more information coming soon!

[h3][i]Thank you for being a part of our story and we hope you have very Happy Holidays![/i][/h3]
[b]The Team[/b]

notes.title: November 2023 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580075/8d89b93e9a2c7dc7a2d3602fe2ac4b6bd65b33ab.png[/img]

[h1]The Countdown has started![/h1]
[b]Once A Tale's release is planned for:[/b] March 2024

Once A Tale is now less than 4 months away from release and we could not be more thrilled! This means you will see more updates like these roll around as we approach the launch.

What you can expect from us until then:
[list]
[*] [b]Content for Once A Tale on Twitch and YouTube[/b]: Watch your favorite streamers test our game!
[*] [b]Livestreams[/b]: We will host livestreams! Q&As and new content, yes please!
[*] [b]Playtests[/b]: There may be more opportunities to playtest Once A Tale before the release.
[*] [b]Devlogs[/b]: We are going to be making Devlogs about Once A Tale's development. If you interested keep reading!
[/list]

[h1]Devlog #01 - Photogrammetry[/h1]

You've asked us what it's like to create a handcrafted game. So here is a video all about the process of creating our handmade characters and props that would become the assets in our game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q50JONbY5o4&t=101

[h1]Growing our Community[/h1]

[h2]Discord[/h2]
Every game strives to have a great welcoming community, and Once A Tale is no different. We recently announced that we had a [b][url=https://discord.gg/4DPBQ8h5Fu]Discord server[/url][/b] that has since had it's first exclusive playtest session. We intend to continue involving our Discord community as much as we can until the release, as well as long after. If you're interested in joining the Once A Tale Discord, if you want a chance to be a part of the story!

[url=https://discord.gg/4DPBQ8h5Fu]Join the Once A Tale Discord[/url]

[h2]Reddit[/h2]
In our strides toward getting Once A Tale more visibility, we created a reddit community. So if you are a fan of Reddit and would like to receive your Once A Tale news on the platform, we would love for you to join our fresh new community!

You can expect to find some content on reddit that we won't share elsewhere:
[list]
[*] Exclusive Q&As
[*] Recap of what's been happening
[*] Art contests and Giveaways
[*] Discussions about the development and content of Once A Tale
[/list]

If that sounds like your cup of tea here is a [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/onceatale/]link to our Reddit community[/url]


We are excited for all of the great things to come. Thank you for your time and for sticking with us!

The Dev Team
